verdict.rationale: The firm documents its own incubator, Prarambh, which it calls India's first legaltech incubator. Prarambh runs a 10-week cohort through a 12-stage programme covering setup, branding, financial and strategic planning, and networking. Selected startups get mentorship, access to CAM's legal minds, beta-testing help, and investor exposure. The program is limited to legaltech startups and to registered businesses at least one year old, and no partnerships with external accelerators or universities are documented. Missing for 10: a program open to early startups outside legaltech, eligibility for pre-incorporation or under-one-year companies, documented partnerships with external accelerators, incubators or university ecosystems, and independent corroboration of program outcomes.
